mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nw_platform_agent_tool_receipts(actor, request_id, fingerprint) VALUES (#{actor}, CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid), #{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT fingerprint, response::text AS response FROM public.nw_platform_agent_tool_receipts WHERE actor = #{actor} AND request_id = CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nw_platform_agent_tool_receipts SET response = CAST(#{response} AS jsonb) WHERE actor = #{actor} AND request_id = CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND response IS NULL
mapper.sql: FROM public.nw_capability_versions v INNER JOIN public.nw_capability_definitions d ON d.id = v.definition_id WHERE v.id = CAST(#{versionId} AS bigint) AND v.capability_type = #{type} AND v.tenant_id IS NULL AND v.trust_level = 'PLATFORM' AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND d.tenant_id IS NULL AND d.trust_level = 'PLATFORM' AND d.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND d.capability_type = #{type}

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'id', v.id::text, 'name', v.name, 'tool_version_id', v.tool_version_id::text, 'tool_definition_id', v.tool_definition_id::text, 'published_revision', v.revision, 'has_unpublished_changes', FALSE, 'provider_type', v.provider_type, 'provider_ref', v.provider_ref, 'environment', v.environment, 'active', v.active, 'revision', v.revision)::text FROM public.nw_platform_agent_tool_deployments h INNER JOIN public.nw_platform_agent_tool_deployment_versions v ON v.id = h.id AND v.revision = h.current_revision
mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', d.id::text, 'name', v.name)::text FROM public.nw_capability_versions v INNER JOIN public.nw_capability_definitions d ON d.id = v.definition_id WHERE v.capability_type = 'SKILL' AND v.tenant_id IS NULL AND v.trust_level = 'PLATFORM' AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND d.tenant_id IS NULL AND d.trust_level = 'PLATFORM' AND d.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND d.default_version_id = v.id ORDER BY v.name, v.id

SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', d.id::text, 'name', v.name)::text FROM public.nw_capability_versions v INNER JOIN public.nw_capability_definitions d ON d.id = v.definition_id WHERE v.capability_type = 'TOOL' AND v.tenant_id IS NULL AND v.trust_level = 'PLATFORM' AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND d.tenant_id IS NULL AND d.trust_level = 'PLATFORM' AND d.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND d.default_version_id = v.id ORDER BY v.name, v.id
WHERE v.active = TRUE ORDER BY v.name, v.id

SELECT (h.draft || jsonb_build_object('id', h.id::text, 'revision', h.draft_revision, 'published_revision', h.current_revision, 'has_unpublished_changes', h.draft_changed))::text FROM public.nw_platform_agent_tool_deployments h ORDER BY h.id

SELECT (h.draft || jsonb_build_object('id', h.id::text, 'revision', h.draft_revision, 'published_revision', h.current_revision, 'has_unpublished_changes', h.draft_changed))::text FROM public.nw_platform_agent_tool_deployments h WHERE h.id = CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nw_platform_agent_tool_deployments(id,current_revision,draft_revision,draft,draft_changed) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS bigint),NULL,1,CAST(#{config} AS jsonb),TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nw_platform_agent_tool_deployments SET current_revision=#{revision},draft_changed=FALSE,updated_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND draft_revision=#{expectedRevision} AND draft_changed=TRUE AND (current_revision IS NULL OR current_revision=#{revision}-1)
mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', id::text,'name', name,'tool_version_id',tool_version_id::text, 'tool_definition_id',tool_definition_id::text,'provider_type',provider_type,'provider_ref',provider_ref, 'environment',environment,'active',active,'revision',revision,'published_revision',revision, 'has_unpublished_changes',FALSE)::text FROM public.nw_platform_agent_tool_deployment_versions WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) ORDER BY revision DESC

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'id', v.id::text, 'name', v.name, 'tool_version_id', v.tool_version_id::text, 'tool_definition_id', v.tool_definition_id::text, 'published_revision', v.revision, 'has_unpublished_changes', FALSE, 'provider_type', v.provider_type, 'provider_ref', v.provider_ref, 'environment', v.environment, 'active', v.active, 'revision', v.revision)::text FROM public.nw_platform_agent_tool_deployment_versions v WHERE v.id = CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND v.revision = #{revision}
SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'id', v.id::text, 'name', v.name, 'definition_id', v.definition_id::text, 'descriptor', v.descriptor)::text
